'''''Carex punctata''''', the '''dotted sedge''', is a species of flowering plant in the [[Cyperaceae]] family. It is native to Macaronesia, northwest Africa, southern, central, and northern Europe, and Turkey.<ref name="301815-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:301815-1 |title=''Carex punctata'' Gaudin |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=14 February 2021 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=''Carex punctata'' dotted sedge |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/157431/i-Carex-punctata-i/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=14 February 2021 }}</ref> Its chromosome number is 2n=68.<ref name="1_of_470_Google_Scholar_Hits" >{{cite journal |title=Evolution in ''Carex'' L. sect. ''Spirostachyae'' (Cyperaceae): A molecular and cytogenetic approach |year=2008 |last1=Escudero |first1=M. |last2=Valcarcel |first2=V. |last3=Vargas |first3=P. |last4=Luceno |first4=M. |journal=Organisms Diversity & Evolution |volume=7 |issue=4 |pages=271–291 |doi=10.1016/j.ode.2006.08.006 |doi-access= |bibcode=2008ODivE...7..271E }}</ref>

== Description ==
''Carex punctata'' is a perennial, tussock-forming plant very similar to ''[[Carex distans]]'', except for the length of the lowest bract, which in ''Carex punctata'' exceeds the inflorescence, whereas in the case of ''Carex distans'' the bract is shorter than the spikelet.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Drescher |first=Anton |date=December 29, 2024 |title=Researchgate |url=https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Carex-punctata-Photo-D-Stesevi-c_fig1_279912067}}</ref> It grows to a height of 40–80 centimetres (16–31 in) tall. Leaf sheaths are brown; blades are green, flat and 3–4.5 millimetres (0.12–0.18 in) wide. The inflorescence consists of one or multiple flower spikes, appearing between March and May.<ref>{{Cite web |last=univerzita |first=Masarykova univerzita, Botanický ústav Akademie věd ČR a Jihočeská |title=Carex punctata • FloraVeg.EU |url=https://floraveg.eu/taxon/overview/Carex%20punctata |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=floraveg.eu}}</ref>

== Distribution and habitat ==
''Carex punctata'' favours sheltered rock ledges and crevices on sea-cliffs. It also grows in salt marshes, and rocky or sandy areas where rivers and streams reach the ocean.<ref>{{Cite web |title=PlantAtlas |url=https://plantatlas2020.org/atlas/2cd4p9h.xem |access-date=2024-12-28 |website=plantatlas2020.org}}</ref>
